Data Engineer 
 We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join the Automation and Intelligence Team of an internationally recognized technology company, supporting its Creative & Productivity and Experience Orchestration business units.
 In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing data integration solutions and pipelines, enabling efficient data processing, analytics, and reporting. You will work with modern technologies such as Python, SQL, Databricks, APIs, and cloud-based data platforms to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.
 Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain data integration pipelines using APIs to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into target systems.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and data transformation scripts.
Build scalable data transformation workflows using Databricks, Python, and Apache Spark.
Work with large datasets to support data processing and advanced analytics.
Develop interactive Power BI reports, dashboards, and visualizations to provide actionable business insights.
Monitor data pipeline performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure data quality and system stability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders to deliver effective data solutions.
Participate in code reviews, contribute to technical improvements, and support team collaboration.
 Requirements 
5+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering.
Strong experience in data integration and data pipeline development.
Advanced SQL skills, including queries, stored procedures, and data transformations.
Hands-on experience with Databricks and Python.
Experience with Apache Spark and large-scale data processing.
Good understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and ETL processes.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS.
Familiarity with Agile software development and CI/CD methodologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with SnapLogic for data integration and pipeline orchestration.
Familiarity with Power Apps.
A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 What We Offer 
The opportunity to work within an internationally recognized technology organization.
Exposure to innovative digital transformation initiatives.
The opportunity to work with modern data engineering technologies and scalable cloud-based solutions.
Collaboration with international and cross-functional teams.
The chance to contribute to projects supporting business intelligence, automation, and advanced analytics.
